verdict.rationale: Better Auth is an authentication framework, and an auth product could plausibly offer AI-generated insights over its user and auth data, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no AI insights or suggestions feature. The hosted MCP server covers documentation search and setup help, and the MCP plugin covers OAuth for MCP clients. Neither generates insights from the user's data, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
